title: Research Proposal: Measuring Altruism, Alignment, and Social Welfare in Large Language Model Agents
description: Historical, superseded May 2026 planning document. It studied whether large language models that appear more aligned, safety-conscious, and prosocial in harmful-request benchmarks also behave more cooperatively in strategic games and more sustainably in multi-agent societies. It is not the current execution protocol: legacy Part 0 and refusal-dependent cross-part claims are invalid, Part 1 is now a focal single-response task, and no composite altruism or readiness score is supported. The current protocol is docs/CONFIRMATORY_PROTOCOL.md.
